senses.definition: Of a system, currently not connected (generally electrically) to a larger network. For example, a power plant which is not connected to the grid, or a computer which is not connected to the Internet or to any other communications service.
examples: I saved the web pages so I could read them later offline.
He only had the option to play offline games because there was no Wi-Fi.
